title: Schneider Electric Half Year 2026 Results
excerpt: The Data Center & Networks end-market continues to see sustained high demand, up triple-digit in Q2.
summary: Schneider Electric's July 30 H1 2026 release reports EUR 21.226 billion revenue, up 14.0% organically, EUR 4.093 billion adjusted EBITA at a 19.3% margin, EUR 2.488 billion net income, EUR 1.631 billion free cash flow, and EUR 4.79 adjusted EPS. Energy Management produced EUR 17.641 billion revenue and a 22.4% adjusted EBITA margin. Data Center & Networks demand rose triple-digit in Q2 and sales grew strong double-digit, led by prefabricated solutions, cooling and three-phase UPS. Net debt reached EUR 15.360 billion; trade working capital absorbed EUR 1.208 billion. The group upgraded 2026 organic revenue growth guidance to 10-13% and adjusted EBITA growth to 14-19% while announcing pending Cognite and AiDASH acquisitions.
